hypotheses.name: A
hypotheses.role: primary (pre-registered before any data was seen)
hypotheses.rule: ridge model on the gated stocks (gap and news agree), trade in the gate's direction when the prediction passes the frozen threshold; entry/stop/threshold chosen in exploration

hypotheses.name: fade
hypotheses.role: secondary, FOUND during exploration (gated gaps reversed intraday); fixed before the hold-out was read, nothing tuned
hypotheses.rule: the same gated stocks, traded AGAINST the gap (gap up -> short, gap down -> long), strongest |gap_atr| first, max 10 a day and 3 per sector, entry at the open, no stop, exit at the close

exploration_in_sample.warning: in-sample: the pattern was noticed on these same sessions

pass.definition: IC > 0 with t > 2.24 AND mean net return per trade at the close > 0

decision_rule: If A passes the hold-out, A goes live. Otherwise, if the fade passes, the fade goes live. If neither passes, A goes live (agreed before seeing data: freeze the best candidate anyway).

live_confirmation.length: the later of 60 sessions and 150 trades
live_confirmation.primary: IC > 0 with t > 2.0 over the confirmation period
live_confirmation.secondary: mean net return per trade at the close > 0
live_confirmation.claimed: only side x entry mode, exit at the close; other horizons are exploratory

costs: 5 bps per side in every net figure; borrow fee 0 for intraday shorts (assumption)
